facts: ShellPlan derives sources/indices/carrier_triangles from one current carrier topology, then faces derives outer/inner/edge sequence from stored counts. Carrier triangulation and thickened shell are deliberately different geometry. Parent-module mutation/native top-bit capacity remain admitted-product questions; normal builder coordinates data, not proof all raw API or >2^31 valid.

Melee capability derives from selected weapon-side and actual body health. Offhand transfer is explicit independent action, no automatic mirrored state. WearableProtection, aggregate LayeredArmor and actual sampled ArmorSurface have distinct whole-layer versus particular-contact semantics; do not require every scalar coverage equal selected anatomical intersection or collapse sameunitfields. Typed simple attributes/style/loadout restrict actual canonical vocabularies; loadout subset intentionally narrower than general attachment topology.

ParametricWeaponCombatGeometry is an admitted physical recipe projection with shape bounds and simple scalar checks; raw public fields can bypass coherent recipe provenance, inherited admission/owner contracts remain. melee_reach derives from controllinggrip distance, condition precision intentionally combines instance geometry with catalogue-relative edgecondition. Expect positive catalogue precision is registry precondition needing actual producer before new API claim, not sufficient generic no-panic proof.
